Advanced Summoner

[[div_ class="manaka-text-box-container"]] [[div_ class="manaka-text-box"]] Wow, you've reached this far! Have you been learning to do pet's PA combos? If not, they are up there!

[[div_ class="text-center manaka-icon-container"]]

Units

Summonners are recommended using TEC-based or PP-based Units. For more information about inits, please see the detailed unit guide, linked below!

[[ul class="nav nav-pills series-nav nav-justified" role="tablist"]] [[li class=""]][[image ./img%3Apso2-ui/ui-unit-rear.png class="pso2-nav-icon"]] Units[[/li]] [[/ul]]

Harmonizer (タクト Takt)

For most of the time, sticking to your regular harmonizer is fine, but higher rarity harmonizer has additional effects. Harmonizers are handy, for one, they don't benefit a +35 grind as +30 is fine. This applies to even Rykros Staff (it affects Rykros, but hardly significant).

Must-have Harmonizers

Icon Name Obtain Description
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-rykrosstaff.png class="pso2-icon double"]] リュクロス・スタッフRykros Staff Zieg TradeDeus ESC-AXHEQ Any Omega Boss [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Sinister Stare (Glance of Darkness) launches a 2000 power projectile attack or 2500 power for Redux (Plus) at every PA during Alter Ego that relies on TEC/T-ATK of the character. [[/span]]The faster the PA, the more extra damage you can do; it roughly adds ~20% to overall damage during Alter Ego.Rykros is still the strongest harmonizer available to attack single target, even when you consider Alter Ego only works 66% of time.Also automatically fulfill Sympathy after 5s (3s if Plus) on Alter Ego: Adds a Shifta tick on Shifta Sympathy and recovers 50% HP on Resta Sympathy.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-roseskewer.png class="pso2-icon double"]] ローズスキュアRose Skewer EQ ChristmasCollection File The basic all-class harmonizer.This is essential to have as it also allows you to use pet when you are raising your subclass.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-ayer.png class="pso2-icon double"]] 闇征奏アジェルリードAyer Reed Zieg TradeUH Primordial Darkness [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Cycle of Fate grants 111% damage, -20% PP cost, and persistent 20 PP regen every 10s.[[/span]]It's PP recovery will take place anytime, even during charging Technics and using PAs.Marginally more powerful than Liberate, and a single purchase costs almost nothing.You don't ned to make it max 35; a +30 will do no different from +35.However, it's only best on Viola and Vulcan, or when you're mobbing with area attack like Jinga Shock.

Optional Harmonizers

Icon Name Obtain Description
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-liberate.png class="pso2-icon double"]] [[span class="rear-icon flag-na"]]Rivalate Harmonizer[[/span]]リバレイトタクトLiberate Takt Zieg Upgrade [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Liberated Ensemble grants 108% damage (111% with Redux), +20% critical rate, and -20% PP cost.[[/span]]One of the strongest ★15 harmonizer, but is still overall weaker than Rykros, except when used with Viola or Vulcan.Since it doesn't come with an S5 like the other Liberate, and is only compatible with 2 pets, only take this if you don't have any use of other Liberate weapons.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-aquaripple.png class="pso2-icon double"]] アクアリプルAqua Ripple L91+ Lizeth Ghidour [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Southern Seas grants 106% damage.[[/span]]If the enemy's weakness attribute match the pet's attribute, Pet recovers 1% damage dealt (maxed at 30HP).This is a good harmonizer for supporting Synchro if it runs low on HP.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-dusk.png class="pso2-icon double"]] ミリオラジダスクMiliorazi Dusk Piper of Disharmony [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Crimson Evening grants 106% damage and persistent 2PP regen every second.[[/span]]This is the strongest all-class harmonizer.It's PP recovery will take place anytime, even during charging Technics and using PAs.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-orb.png class="pso2-icon double"]] ミリオラジオーブMiliorazi Orb Piper of DisharmonyCobalt Medal Shop [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Crimson Evening grants 106% damage and persistent 2PP every second.[[/span]]This is similar to Dusk Takt, but it's Summoner only.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-nemesis.png class="pso2-icon double"]] [[span class="rear-icon flag-na"]]Nemesis Barl[[/span]]ネメシスバール-NTNemesis Bar-NT Zieg TradeTainted Area [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Purifying Melody (Sacred Melody) generates a barrier in 20s which provides 40% player damage resistance and -30% PP cost.[[/span]]The barrier will dissipate when the weapon is swapped to non-Nemesis weaponry or player gets hit; the barrier will then regenerate in 20s.Fortunately, hits transferred by Alter Ego doesn't dissipate the barrier.If you keep out of reach of enemy attack and let your pet takes the hate, this is a solid choice.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-slave.png class="pso2-icon double"]] [[span class="rear-icon flag-na"]]Raven Barl[[/span]]スレイヴバール-NTSlave Bar-NT Zieg TradeTainted Area [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Notes of Temptation (Enticing Melody) generates a barrier in 20s which provides 40% attack PP recovery, 30% natural PP recovery, and negates nockback.[[/span]]The barrier will dissipate when the weapon is swapped to non-Raven weaponry or player gets hit; the barrier will then regenerate in 20s.Fortunately, hits transferred by Alter Ego doesn't dissipate the barrier.If you keep out of reach of enemy attack and let your pet takes the hate, this is a solid choice.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-ares.png class="pso2-icon double"]] アーレスタクト-NTAres Takt-NT Zieg TradeTainted Area [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Phantasmal Song grants 103% damage when photon blast gauge is not full and 104% if it is full.[[/span]]Upon using a Photon Blast, this harmonizer will gain an extra effect based on Photon Blast while the harmonizer is equipped: Helix grants an additional 104% damage; Ajax grants +40% attack PP recovery; Cetus grants +30% natural PP recovery; Julius grants 12% damage resistance Ilios grants -15% PP cost.Switching to different harmonizer and back will retain the effect; the effect lasts until you return to campship.Supposedly, if you have multiple mag with different Photon Blasts, you can have all the effect at once if you keep switching mag and do different Photon Blasts.Nevertheless, even with just Cetus, this harmonizer can contribute well to PP regeneration, especially if you use a Redran set.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-gurennoyomimusubi.png class="pso2-icon double"]] グレンノヨミムスビGuren no Yomimusubi Zieg Upgrade [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Crimson Flame Melody grants 102% damage and further 103% damage when attacking elemental weak enemy; total damage is 105.06%.[[/span]]Automatically applies Shifta every 14 seconds to character and pet; Shifta roughly increases pet damage by a whooping 8%.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-zara.png class="pso2-icon double"]] セレシオコプス・ザラCeres Cicopus Zara UH Gal GryphonZieg Upgrade [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Immortal Moment grants 103% damage.[[/span]]If you hit an enemy 10 times, a barrier will activate with further boosts damage by 103% (total of 106.09%) and cuts damage by 10% for both you and pet.The barrier will dissipate 15s after the last hit performed.This is the second most powerful ★14 harmonizer, but you will need to go all the way to upgrade it (collecting Hunting Stones from Naberius/Amduscia/Wopal XH Fields) if Gryphon doesn't drop you one.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-dim.png class="pso2-icon double"]] ディムタクトDim Takt Divide Quest [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Darkened Performance grants 103% damage and 10% damage resistance to both player and pets.[[/span]]You can buy this harmonizer on player shop and it's a bit better than any initial harmonizers, provided you can grind it.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-nt.png class="pso2-icon double"]] タクト-NTHarmonizer Default (NA Server) [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Healing Wind grants 126% Resta healing.[[/span]]This is a good harmonizer to start out on North American server, considering the Japanese server only get a twig.

Forgettable Harmonizers

Icon Name Obtain Description
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-cras.png class="pso2-icon double"]] 光纏奏クラースリードCras Reed Zieg Upgrade [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Lightsong Guardian grants 111% damage, and the effect of Cycle of Fate: -20%PP Cut, and persistent 20PP regen every 10s.[[/span]]Upon doing 3 normal attacks, the initial 111% damage boost is retained, but the[[span class="icon op-pot"]]Cycle of Fate effects are discarded in favor of extra 104% damage (total of 115.44% damage), damage taken -30%, and super armor.[[/span]]The new effect lasts 30s and has 30s cooldown.Taking account the amount of material required to make this Harmonizer and the fact that you cannot convert it to another weapon, it's completely disappointing as the prime pets for this Harmonizer benefits a lot more from it's predecessor, Ayer.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-banstil.png class="pso2-icon double"]] バンスティルBan Stil Zieg Upgrade [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Steadfast Solo grants 110% damage and Pet regenerates 10% HP every 10 seconds.[[/span]]However, if you get hit, the damage multiplier will be reduced by 1% and the pet-healing property is gone.Minimum multiplier is 106% and will regenerate at 0.4% per second, totaling at 10s to be maxed.When the multiplier is back at 110%, the pet-healing property will return.Damage transferred by Alter Ego counts and will reduce the multiplier.Since the harmonizer doesn't come with damage reduction, natural PP regeneration, or automatic PP regeneration like other Stil, this stick is a waste of effort; go make other Stil instead.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-banpuras.png class="pso2-icon double"]] バンピュラスBan Puras Zieg Upgrade [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Effortless Solo is similar to Steadfast solo, minus the pet-healing property.[[/span]]Please skip this and make another Puras.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-novel.png class="pso2-icon double"]] ノヴェルタクトNovel Takt Weapon Badge Shop 2020 [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Sealing Duet grants 103% damage and +20% critical rate.[[/span]]This harmonizer doesn't have much use, unless you want to upgrade it to Liberate.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-lightstream.png class="pso2-icon double"]] 光跡奏カンシオンLightstream Canxion Zieg UpgradeXH+ Dark Falz Persona [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Lightstream Melody grants 105% damage (108% with Plus), restores PP fully when PP drops below 20% and further 103% damage for 30 seconds; total damage during boost is 108.15% (11.24% with Plus).[[/span]]Boost and PP restore has 2 minutes cooldown.This works the boost average to be 100.75% (based on an 8 minute EQ), making your actual damage boost about 105.7875%, or 108.81% if Plus.Being marginally better than Guren, only take this if you don't have any use of other Lightstream weapons, or if you need a PP battery.The Plus upgrade makes this marginally better than Liberate; if you have spare Amphitrite Stone and Emer, you can go for it.This harmonizer also extends Dark Blast duration by 10 seconds if you have it equipped during the transformation sequence (The time increase is always 10s regardless of potential level).
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-celestial.png class="pso2-icon double"]] 星震奏カンシオンCelestial Canxion Zieg UpgradeXH+ Dark Falz Persona [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Star-bound Melody grants 105% damage, restores 30% PP when PP drops below 20%, and increases Dark Blast time by 10 seconds if you have this harmonizer equipped during the transformation sequence.[[/span]]The PP restore effect of Celestial and Lightstream is shared, so you have no reason to carry both harmonizers.You can upgrade this to Lightstream harmonizer.This harmonizer also extends Dark Blast duration by 10 seconds if you have it equipped during the transformation sequence (The time increase is always 10s regardless of potential level).
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-profound.png class="pso2-icon double"]] 深遠奏カンシオンProfound Canxion Zieg TradeXH+ Dark Falz Persona [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Malicious Melody grants 105% damage and increases Dark Blast time by 10 seconds if you have this harmonizer equipped during the transformation sequence.[[/span]]Not much use considering the availability of Rykros.You can upgrade this to Celestial harmonizer.This harmonizer also extends Dark Blast duration by 10 seconds if you have it equipped during the transformation sequence (The time increase is always 10s regardless of potential level).
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-allure.png class="pso2-icon double"]] アリュールヴィネーラAllure Venera SH+ Omega ApprenticeSH+ Omega Falz Apprentice [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Bewitching Performance increases Dark Blast gauge speed and increases Dark Blast Apprentice time by 7 seconds.[[/span]]If you like Dark Blast Apprentice like me, then you might have a use for this, but otherwise, the Profound harmonizer is better if you just want Dark Blast time extension.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-atraex.png class="pso2-icon double"]] アトラタハト・イクスAtlas Tahat Ex UH Dragon,Zieg Upgrade [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Eternal War Scherzo grants 106% damage and grants pet 1 time protection against stun.[[/span]]The ★14 Atra/Atlas Harmonizer is drop-only from UH Dragon, and you cannot convert any Atra/Atlas weapon into a harmonizer.Seeing that this has the same power as Orb Harmonizer and that one is easily available from Cobalt Medal Shop, this harmonizer is pretty pointless.If you're lucky enough to get one, you can either keep it for form, or trade it for a Time Stone Chronos.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-atra.png class="pso2-icon double"]] アトラタハトAtlas Tahat UH Dragon [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Millennium Timber grants 103% damage.[[/span]]Considering this harmonizer is a drop-only and you cannot make it like other Atras weaponry, it's considered to be useless.If you're lucky enough to get one, you can either keep it for form, or trade it for a Time Stone Chronos.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-lumiere.png class="pso2-icon double"]] リュミエルアルモニーLumiere Harmonie Zieg Upgrade [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Templar's Melody grants 102% damage and grants pet 1 time protection against stun.[[/span]]This is a weaker Atlas Ex harmonizer, and it's only good for it's form.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-jutus.png class="pso2-icon double"]] ジュティスアルモニーJutus Harmonie SH+ Enchanted Forest [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Knight's Melody grants pet 1 time protection against stun.[[/span]]It's only good for it's form.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-zeinesis.png class="pso2-icon double"]] ゼイネシスピックZeinesis Pick Deus EQ [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Melody of Life, increases your base attack (not damage!) by 2% and restores 10% HP every 30 seconds.[[/span]]The attack raise is capped at 2%, thus having multiple Zeinesis potential in one party will have no extra effect.This harmonizer can swap its potential to its Qliphad/Clifard version.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-qliphadpick.png class="pso2-icon double"]] [[span class="rear-icon flag-na"]]Clifard Pick[[/span]]クリファドピックQliphad Pick Deus EQ [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Malicious Melody (Melody of Evil) increases natural PP regeneration by 10% and attack PP regain by 15%.[[/span]]It's good to help you with PP recovery, but it's not really worth the need of 120 Qliphad Fuse.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-homura.png class="pso2-icon double"]] ホムラノヨミムスビHomura no Yomimusubi Weapon Badge SP Shop 1 [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Melody of Flame (Flame Melody) grants 101% damage and further 103% damage when attacking elemental weak enemy; total damage is 104.03%.[[/span]]This harmonizer can be and must be upgraded to Guren harmonizer to have any use.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-ceres.png class="pso2-icon double"]] セレシオコプスCeres Cicopus Stone Trade [[span class="icon op-pot"]]Immortal Retainer grants 103% damage.[[/span]]If you hit an enemy 10 times, a barrier will activate with further boosts damage by 102% (total of 105.06%).The barrier will dissipate 15s after the last hit performed.This harmonizer can be and must be upgraded to Zara harmonizer to have any use.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-evledaanhks.png class="pso2-icon double"]] イヴリダアンクスEvleada Anhks SH+ Enchanted Forest Recovers 3 PP when an enemy is killed nearby.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-cleasisanhks.png class="pso2-icon double"]] クリシスアンクスCleasis Anhks Zieg Upgrade Grants 103% damage during Buster Quest Defense Phase.Also recovers 3 PP when an enemy is killed nearby.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-schvelleanhks.png class="pso2-icon double"]] シュベルアンクスSchvelle Anhks Zieg Upgrade Grants 103% damage during Buster Quest Attack Phase.Also recovers 3 PP when an enemy is killed nearby.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-yukikaze.png class="pso2-icon double"]] [[span class="rear-icon flag-na"]]Impending Gale[[/span]]幽揮風Yukikaze Weapon Badge SP Shop 3 This harmonizer can be used as a crutch to fight solo Profound Darkness, but other than that's it's just a pretty harmonizer.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-revolucio.png class="pso2-icon double"]] タクトレボルシオTakt Revolucio Does nothing.Form maybe useful if you're into it.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-golem1.png class="pso2-icon double"]] レスタゴレムナセルResta Golem Nacelle SH+ Enchanted Forest The only thing meaner than hoping your friend to step on a lego, is to chance upon this harmonizer.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-takt/wp-ta-golem2.png class="pso2-icon double"]] レスタゴレムナチュラResta Golem Natura SH+ Enchanted Forest Same deal as it's brethren
